title: cirsium bulbosum subsp. anglicum
intro: Cirsium bulbosum subsp. anglicum, commonly known as the English thistle, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to the British Isles and Western Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium bulbosum subsp. anglicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The plant's bioactive constituents also include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been found to have anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
